title: 250 Adventure
description: The KTM 250 Adventure is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Adventure Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 250cc engine generating 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
